_notes: Castle battle (docs/specs/SPEC-castle-battle.md). grid: board size in tiles [w, h]. path: one axis-aligned polyline in tiles through tile centres, from the left castle (side 0) to the right castle (side 1); both sides walk it in opposite directions. Distances on the path are measured from side 0's castle; side 1 uses length - d. forts.atPct: fort positions as % of path length. summonBasePct: how far (% of path) a side may summon before it holds a fort; summonGapTiles: the summon zone also stops this far short of the nearest enemy unit, but never short of homeZoneTiles: the castle gate (0 to homeZoneTiles from our castle) is always open, even with enemies on it. mana: startPvp (a ranked/league 1v1 match starts with this much; PvE stages set their own later), max (the bank cannot hold more), regenSec is one point every everySec while the match clock is in [fromSec, toSec). sizes: mana cost band [min, max] per size and perMatch = times EACH card of that size may be summoned in one match (null = unlimited) unless the card sets its own perMatch (sects.json roster.units). kinds: the Thai name of each card kind (sects.json roster.units kind; no kind = disciple). moves: role (บุก = attacker: walks forward from where it lands; สกัด = interceptor: holds its post), walking speed in tiles/s per move, its Thai name and what it does (card text). guardLeashTiles: a guard walks out to the nearest enemy it can hit that comes within this many tiles of where it was summoned, and walks back there when none is left; it never crosses forts or hits structures. meleeRange: range in tiles of units whose range is 0 or below it. supportHeal: HP a support unit heals per hit on the most-hurt ally in range; supportGapTiles: how far it stays behind the front ally. critPct: chance a metal-kit unit hits for double. Unit on-hit kit (sects.json roster.units, all optional): splash (tiles: the hit also lands on every enemy it can hit this close to the target), slowSec (walks status.slowPct % slower), rootSec (cannot walk, still fights), stunSec (does nothing; control resistance: once a stun ends the unit cannot be stunned again for status.stunImmuneSec, once a root ends it cannot be rooted for status.rootImmuneSec, a large unit takes status.largeControlPct % of any stun or root, and slows never stack: a new one only refreshes the time), pushTiles (knocked back toward its own castle; never a large unit), groundSec (burning ground of radius status.groundRadius at what it hits; a flier also drops it where it flies, once per cooldown), armor (flat damage taken off every hit, at least 1 gets through), pierce (ignores armor), raisePct (a small enemy this unit's hit kills rises on this unit's side with raisePct % of its HP). Every unit has tagTh (one-line Thai role and what it counters) and counters (keys of counterTags). A unit deals counterPct % more damage to a target of a class one of its counters names (the best one counts): large = size large, air = fliers, swarm = small units, guard = guards, capture = capturers, attacker = medium marchers and fliers, dragon = kind dragon, structure = forts and castles. hand: the 7 cards a side holds in a match: the basic capturer of the leader's element (hand.basic, cost 1, unlimited; a sectless yinyang leader brings the metal one), the leader, the sub-leader, then the cards the player picked (deck.pick of them, no draw, SPEC-deck-budget), at most maxLarge large ones in all. abilities: what a card's ability (sects.json roster.units ability.kind) does at its level's value v: aura = every ally within radiusTiles of the unit (itself too) deals v % more damage (the strongest aura counts, they do not add up); ward = every ally within radiusTiles of the unit (itself too) takes v % less damage from hits (not burn or poison; the strongest ward counts); hp = the unit has v % more HP; refund = summoning it gives v mana back. A card's level is 3 as the leader, 2 as the sub-leader, 1 otherwise. sectTeams: the default leader and sub-leader of each sect's collection (every roster card of that sect), used by the bots, the AI and as the team screen's starting pick. dot: burn and poison (fire-sect / wood-sect units), ticking every 0.5 s; each hit adds a stack up to burnMaxStacks / poisonMaxStacks (dps per stack) and restarts the timer, burning ground keeps at least one burn stack. fort: hp, dmg per shot, rate shots/s, range and captureRadius in tiles, captureSec = time a capture unit must hold a neutral fort with no enemy on it. castle: same shape (it shoots by itself); cannon = the player's own shot (a 'cannon' command at a depth d up to reachTiles from our castle): costs mana, then cannot fire again for cooldownSec; deals dmg to every enemy (ground or air) within radiusTiles of d, armor applies, and knocks the maxPush nearest small ones among them back pushTiles toward their castle. matchSec: match length. results: the Thai name of each result type: total = the enemy castle falls while we hold every fort, castle = it falls, hp = time is up and our castle has more HP, tiebreak = equal HP decided by forts held, then mana left, units alive, enemies killed; draw = both castles fall on the same tick or everything is equal.

Those 6 non-basic cards hold at most hand.maxLarge large ones and cost at most budget deck points (a campaign.json stage may set its own deckBudget). A card's points: cardPoints[id] if set, else its mana + sizePoints[size]. loaners: cards an account that owns fewer than 6 non-basic cards may borrow into its picks, one per card it lacks. Tuned with npm run sim:deck (deck-budget-research.md section 10).
